name: distill-source-to-skill
job: Distill docs, repos, or notes into one installable Skill package with mechanisms, not summaries.

inScope: Naming the evidence boundary and audience/sensitivity/license
Extracting mechanism cards with decision rules and failure modes
Choosing the smallest package shape and validating locally
Adding eval prompts and artifact-shape assertions
outOfScope: Revising an existing package in place (author-skill)
Publishing secrets, customer data, or private topology

inputs: Source material: docs, repos, notes, transcripts, media
outputs: Installable skill package with concise metadata and workflow
Validation run results with honest residual gaps

tools: target repository validator and catalog generator
data: evidence boundary of actually read sources

failureSemantics: Mechanisms that do not change future agent behavior are discarded; no skill depends on private tools, credentials, or hidden chat context; validation failures are reported honestly, never published as benchmark quality.

outcome.observable: A compact installable skill package that runs without the original source, names its evidence boundary, carries output contracts and validation signals, and passes the target repository's structural validation.
